messages:
Elaine (platform): Heads-up: planning a small runtime + tracing tweak deploy today at 16:30 PT. Canary for 30m then a full rollout if green. Need someone to own smoke checks + rollback readiness. Small observability changes included (dash panels + trace sampling). :eyes:
Matt (engops): I can own smoke checks. Will run through checklist during canary and post results. Do we have the updated dashboard links? :white_check_mark:
Elaine (platform): Awesome. Dash links: https://dash.internal/redwood/runtime-smoke and https://dash.internal/redwood/traces-smoke. Quick smoke items: 1) p95 latency < 300ms, 2) 5xx rate < 0.5%, 3) KV cache hit rate not dropping >5% from baseline, 4) trace span error count <= baseline + small delta, 5) tokens/sec throughput within 10%. Also confirm sample rate for traces increases to 2x during canary.
Priya (sre): I'll tune alerts during the window. Plan: mute the noisy low-severity runtime flapping alerts and temporarily raise the p95 alert threshold to 350ms for 40m. Will re-enable after rollout. If anything crosses critical error rate, I'll escalate. Leaving audit entries for change.
Matt (engops): Copy. My smoke checklist (quick):
```
- curl /health -> 200
- run 3 x 1k token requests to main model route, measure p95
- run embedding batch job sample (100 requests)
- check KV cache hit metric (dashboard)
- tail logs for errors matching "kv-miss" or "kernel-fallback"
```
I'll paste results here as I run them.
Nate (runtime): FYI the tracing change is in the same PR as a tiny kernel selection fallback tweak. I tested locally, but if we want strictly separated risk, we can delay trace sampling until after runtime patch. Thoughts?
Elaine (platform): Prefer to ship both together to get traces for the new code path. But if Priya thinks it increases risk, we can decouple. Priya?
Priya (sre): Given tests, small risk. I'll be standing by and can hit rollback if error budget climbs quickly. Agree to proceed together but put stricter rollback conditions: 2x baseline 5xx or p95 > 400ms for 5 min -> immediate rollback.
Matt (engops): noted. I'll watch error rate and p95 and report at +10m, +20m, +30m. If anything triggers, I'll ping @Elaine and @Priya and mark rollout paused. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deploy started by matt at 1893456789 (canary). CI: passed, image: runtime-v2.3.1-canary
Matt (engops): Canary results at +15m: p95 260ms, 5xx 0.12%, cache hit steady, no new trace errors. Continuing to +30m. :white_check_mark:
Matt (engops): Canary complete +30m: p95 255ms, 5xx 0.08%. Rolling to 100%. Elaine / Priya — who is primary for rollback on full rollout?
Elaine (platform): I'll own rollback for full rollout window. Priya remains escalation lead for alerts. Nate will be on-call for runtime fixes. Thanks team — will post postmortem if any anomalies. :tada:
